headline: Read the air-Q sensors at home
intro: Connect an air-Q device to Home Assistant to create separate entities for its sensors. Readings can include temperature, humidity, gases, particulates, noise, and the Health, Performance, Mold, and Virus indices, depending on the sensors found in your device.
highlights: Create separate entities for the sensors found in your air-Q device
View measurements such as temperature, humidity, CO2, particulates, noise, and pressure where supported
Explore Health, Performance, Mold, and Virus indices, which use a scale from 0% (High Risk) to 100% (No Risk/Optimal)

flow.title: From air-Q device to Home Assistant sensors
stages: Connect air-Q and Home Assistant to the same Wi-Fi network
Confirm discovery with the device password, or enter its IP address or first 5 serial characters and password
View separate entities for sensors found on the device
